payout_quote: Official sitterradar.co.uk 'Become a Pet Sitter': 'Playing with pets while get good pay - You can get 85% of the total payment of each bookings; we only take 15% for website maintenance.' And under Platform Fees: 'Sitter Radar keeps a 15% service fee from each completed booking and pays you the remaining 85%. There is no subscription and no joining fee.'
steps: Click 'Become a Sitter' on sitterradar.co.uk and create your sitter profile with basic info, bio, and photo.
Create at least 1 listing: choose services (boarding, house sitting, dog walking, drop-ins), animal types, and preferences.
Set up payment via their payments partner Stripe (individual/sole trader account).
Accept local booking requests; complete the service.
Earnings become eligible for payout once the booking is complete and its end date is at least 7 days in the past; Sitter Radar pays you 85%.
catches: Sitter Radar keeps a 15% service fee from each completed booking — you receive 85% of your set rate.
UK-only platform; useless outside the UK.
Payouts are delayed: earnings eligible only after booking completion + 7 days past the end date.
You set your own rates so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings; self-employed (sole trader), no benefits.
biggest_catch: UK-only and variable: you keep 85% of your own set rate after the 15% fee, but there is no fixed pay, no guaranteed bookings, and payouts are held until 7+ days after each booking ends.
eligibility: Over 18, UK-based, pet experience (owned/fostered/sat for friends/family); self-employed individuals only (not businesses).
timing: Profile setup under an hour; paid via Stripe after booking completion + 7-day holding period.
